task_description: Clarify expert catalog additions for roundtable expert skills MVP
initial_idea: Add 13 named expert/persona skills to the roundtable task skill catalog, with npx skills add commands, and classify other referenced skills as boundary-generation or book-distillation helpers.

rounds.question: 这些 `npx skills add ...` 清单，你希望首版怎么处理：把 13 个专家作为内置可选专家 presets 固定放进页面，还是要在页面里提供“安装/添加 skill”的能力？
rounds.answer: 可以变为基于问题判断用这13个专家其中的一个，同时允许用户增加skill的能力
rounds.notes: User expanded from fixed selectable expert presets to question-based routing and user-added skills.

rounds.question: “允许用户增加 skill”在首版里应该做到哪一层：只是让用户手动填写一个 skill 名称/描述/安装命令并保存成本地 preset，还是要真的执行 `npx skills add ...`、读取安装后的 skill 内容并自动解析成专家？
rounds.answer: 用户反问：哪种效果更好呢
rounds.notes: Recommendation given: manual/local skill preset addition first; automated install/parse deferred.

rounds.question: 是否按这个边界定稿：首版允许用户手动新增本地 skill preset，但 `npx skills add` 只作为来源命令保存和展示，不在页面里执行？
rounds.notes: Manual local preset add/edit in scope; executing npx and automatic GitHub skill parsing out of scope.

rounds.question: 基于问题自动判断时，你希望系统默认只选出“最适合的 1 个专家”来回答，还是推荐“最适合的 3 个专家”自动组成圆桌讨论？
rounds.notes: Routing should recommend multiple experts, not single expert.

rounds.question: 是否把首版验收线定为：输入问题后，系统默认从内置 13 个 + 用户新增 presets 中推荐 `Top 3` 专家组成圆桌；用户可以手动增减推荐结果，但最终至少保留 2 个专家再生成讨论？
rounds.notes: Acceptance criteria resolved: default Top 3 from built-in plus user-added presets; user can adjust; final generation requires at least 2 experts.

codebase_context.evidence: Existing spec and approved ralplan plan exist; current directory still has no package.json/src app source. Approved plan currently treats expert presets as local data and excludes import/edit UI and live GitHub sync.

progress_report.handoff: Apply addendum to approved ralplan or run ralplan again for formal plan update.
